title: PromptModule
description: A versioned prompt/instruction module in the control-plane prompt library. Every model call at runtime must reference a PromptModule (a taskType pinned to a frozen version) plus its declared output schema; ad-hoc unversioned prompts are refused by the registry resolver. See registry/prompts/README.md for the full contract.

taskType.description: Kebab-case task identifier; the registry key a runtime resolves on.

version.description: Version label (v1, v2, ...). A published (taskType, version) is immutable.

description.description: What this module is for and when a caller should use it.

modelTierHint.description: Cheapest model tier that can do the task: low=flash/LOW, med=balanced, high=pro/HIGH. Used by phase-2 model gateway for routing.

modelFamilyHint.description: Optional model-family preference, e.g. 'flash/LOW' or a specific vendor family.

status.description: Lifecycle state. Only 'published' versions may be resolved at runtime.

parameters.description: Optional sampling parameters the gateway should use (adapted from the intelligence prompt_tuner LLMParameters pattern).

bodyRefs.description: Named pointers to prompt body content, relative to the module file's directory (the modules/ dir). At least one part is required; system and user are the conventional parts.

outputSchema.description: Reference (relative path from the module file's directory) to the JSON Schema that the model output must satisfy.
